alternatives.P1_STOCKS: 0-5 selected names at 15% each plus the residual asset SPY (the official weekly policy's own construction)

costs.convention: weekly-passive-first-v1 switchCost: round trip of the stock plus round trip of the ETF leg it displaces

coverage.belowFloor: BLOCKED: identities and counts only, no per-name signal, no weights
coverage.setBy: the weekly coverage audit (outcome-blind), after which no return was read

execution.entry: close of the next US session (execution session 0)
execution.exit: close of the 126th US session after the execution session
execution.returnBasis: as-traded forward total return (price_adjustment.to_total_return); gross of withholding tax

failureConditions: coverage below the weekly floor on a signal date (BLOCKED receipt, never a filled value)
any registered parameter changes after approval (a new study id is required)
an unresolved terminal outcome among matured receipts (verdict withheld)
benchmark data integrity not PASS for SPY or QQQ (headline withheld)
the feature version or digest rule differs from US_SHAREHOLDER_DISTRIBUTION_V1 (receipts refused)

derived.incrementalDistributionOverOCF: (D - D/(1+g)) / OCF = distributionToOCF * g / (1+g), D = totalCashDistributionTTM, g = totalCashDistributionChangeYoY

dilution.reason: period-end share count is present on 1.8% of stored filings; sharesOutstandingChangeYoY is BLOCKED

gates.rule: a positive close exists at or before the signal date, at most 10 calendar days old, with at least 272 prior sessions
the sector label published in the membership snapshot (or an earlier one) is one of the eleven sector names
a filing is visible before the signal date and its report period ended at most 180 days before it
['totalCashDistributionTTM', 'totalCashDistributionChangeYoY', 'operatingCashFlowTTM', 'distributionToOCF'] all have a usable measurement and operatingCashFlowTTM > 0

hypothesis.economic: A company that materially increases its shareholder cash distributions, with the increase supported by operating cash flow and without excessive share dilution, may carry information about its next 126-session return relative to a passive index that is not already in its price momentum, value or quality.
notClaimed: dilution-adjusted distribution growth (not testable from the store)
stock selection skill from a benchmark change (SPY to QQQ moves levels, not ranks)
hypothesis.primaryClaim: The predeclared policy P1_STOCKS, net of switching costs, earns more than BOTH passive SPY and passive QQQ over 126 sessions, on the same signal weeks and the same selected names.

inference.blockedWeeks: a BLOCKED week held no names, so the book was 100% residual SPY; it is evaluated as exactly that (excess vs SPY zero), never dropped
inference.method: moving-block bootstrap of the weekly mean, block length 26 weeks (one horizon), 10000 replicates, one-sided 95%
inference.overlap: consecutive weekly horizons share 121 of 126 sessions

statistics.identity: theta_QQQ = theta_SPY - mean(R(QQQ) - R(SPY)) exactly; the spread is reported, never re-ranked
statistics.theta_QQQ: mean over matured weeks of net(P1) - R(QQQ)
statistics.theta_SPY: mean over matured weeks of net(P1) - R(SPY)

maturityGate.meaning: no SUCCESS or FAILURE may be declared before this; earlier statistics are descriptive

secondary: decomposition: selection contribution vs SPY and passive growth spread QQQ-SPY
growth loading: regression of the weekly SPY excess on the QQQ-SPY spread (intercept = growth-adjusted selection)
selection null: random names from the gate-passing set and from the eligible set, same count and sector cap
incremental cross-sectional rank information beyond price and quality ranks (benchmark invariant)

selection.rank: incrementalDistributionOverOCF descending, ties by ticker ascending

universe.identity: a symbol whose price panel or fundamentals belong to a different issuer is IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS and excluded
universe.membership: S&P 500, latest membership snapshot strictly earlier than the signal date
universe.signalDate: last completed US session of each calendar week
universe.survivorship: departed members stay in the cross-section while they were members; a name that stops trading while held has no outcome until a terminal consideration is cited (never a last price, never zero)

verdicts.FAILURE: gate met AND the one-sided 95% upper bound of theta_SPY < 0 OR of theta_QQQ < 0 (the policy is worse than a passive alternative it would replace)
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: gate met and neither SUCCESS nor FAILURE, or any matured portfolio outcome unresolved
verdicts.SUCCESS: gate met AND lower bound of theta_SPY > 0 AND lower bound of theta_QQQ > 0 AND no unresolved terminal outcome AND the policy held at least one name in at least 10% of matured weeks
verdicts.multiplicity: one primary claim, tested as an intersection of two one-sided tests; each at 5%, both must pass, so the family-wise size is at most 5% and no correction applies. Secondary diagnostics are Holm-adjusted among themselves and carry no verdict power.
verdicts.singleLook: the first verdict at the gate is the verdict; later updates are continuation reports and cannot reverse it
